title: The Traveling Pulse
premise: A messenger wants to send a signal along a row of spring-linked blocks, but assumes a marked block must travel to the receiver. The pulse arrives while the marked block oscillates near its starting position.
hook: Does the messenger move, or does the message?
visible_action: A colored block rocks locally as a compression pulse travels through a spring-linked row.
intended_takeaway_or_theme: A wave can transfer a disturbance while local material moves differently.
gate: Specify a longitudinal mechanical-wave model; do not generalize it to all waves.

style_application.why: Progressive drawing separates the disturbance from the motion of individual elements.
style_application.check: Check the actual model and ensure texture does not change element positions.

editorial_pick.original_reason: A traveling pulse can separate movement of a disturbance from movement of the material.
editorial_pick.proposed_first_version: Use marked elements in a visible row. Track a few elements while the pulse travels through the group.
editorial_pick.gate: Check the model and boundary conditions. Do not generalize one wave type to all waves.
